name: uderia-database
description: Centralized database connections (Teradata, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, DuckDB, MongoDB, JDBC) shared by every participant — the Canvas, the Database Navigator, agent queries, PDM deployment and other data consumers. A User-type connector: each user manages their own connections; the admin governs availability.

auth_schema.description: Add and manage your database connections — relational databases and MongoDB. Used by the Canvas, the Database Navigator, agent queries, industry-model PDM deployment, and other data features.
